int_name: N BROAD ST & W LEHIGH AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk but no pedestrian refuge island, leading to significant exposure. While sidewalks and transit stops are present, the large crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signaling or traffic calming measures create a moderately hostile environment.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a long duration across multiple lanes without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the roadway

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracks and wear in the crosswalk area could cause tripping or reduced visibility of markings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic to improve driver awareness and visibility of the crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, signals, and a bus shelter. However, the environment is dominated by wide roadways with multiple lanes, resulting in long crossing distances and significant exposure to vehicle traffic without physical refuge.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The excessive width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection of Broad St and Lehigh Ave

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median or refuge island leaves pedestrians vulnerable if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial intersection with a commercial and industrial character. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and a median refuge island are present, the environment is dominated by high-speed vehicle design and long pedestrian crossing distances.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: Wide travel lanes and lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds through the intersection.

hazards.name: Faint crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are faded and lack high-visibility patterns, reducing driver awareness.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian signals with countdown timers are installed and visible to provide clear crossing information.
